photo.caption: Setup of a solar shade canopy for humanitarian aid and disaster relief. The solar shade has the potential to provide enough energy for continuous 24-hour use.
photo.description: U.S. Army Pacific and U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Soldiers along with other support elements, work on erecting a solar shade canopy during the setup of a humanitarian aid and disaster relief event for Rim of the Pacific training exercise at Ford Island, July 7. Besides providing shade and energy, the solar shade reduces the heat signature of the equipment setup underneath it.
